summary: Rewrote the reader-facing console pages for the tree-search and terminal-policy-iteration families, replacing eight machine-generated drafts and two family pages with hand-written four-altitude pages. Tree search: the family page plus mcts, nnue-guided, observable-mcts and puct; terminal policy iteration: the family page plus deployment-panel, public-regenerative-b0, public-rollout-policy-iteration, public-survival-rollout, terminal-policy-iteration and terminal-rollout. Every number is quoted from history.md, experiment-index.md or an exploratory finding with its evidence label attached, task-record-only verdicts are marked as unquotable, and the unrun PUCT lab is described as having no retained result. No research record, protocol or source file was modified.
